OnBoardingSlide1Desc: We understand that campus life can be exhausting. Here, you can take time to reflect on your feelings, thoughts, and needs—free from judgment.
OnBoardingSlide2Desc: This app is your companion on the journey to mental wellness. From journaling to access to professional help—all in one safe and private space.
OnBoardingSlide3Desc: It’s time to give space for yourself. Begin your journey toward better mental health—one small step, one mindful moment at a time.
OnBoardingSlide4Desc: This is your safe space to feel, reflect, and grow. No need to be perfect—just be you, one moment at a time.
CounselingHeadDesc: Choose a topic and start talking about your issues safely and comfortably.
